==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Qianling:''' Hi there. I heard that Pioneer Explorers are informed travelers. Maybe you can answer my friend's little question here?
:'''Qianling:''' There's so much talk about the Magistrate's guest. My friend thinks... it's actually him!
:'''Qianling:''' My friend's a seasoned traveler. He walks a thousand miles a day and lifts a thousand catties with his bare hands...
:'''Shangwen:''' Hold on. You're talking about yourself, aren't you?
